results.title: Supabase vs Firebase: Pro From $25, 100K Users [2026]
results.content: Supabase log pricing, September 25. Supabase announced usage-based pricing for log ingestion and queries. Existing organizations received a grace period that extends into early 2027, while the treatment of newly created organizations is less certain. The lesson: a platform fee is not the whole bill, and observability data can become a metered line item overnight. [...] Supabase announced a Turso acquisition on October 2, 2026, switched on usage-based pricing for logs on September 25, and put an MCP server in front of AI agents. Google, by contrast, reportedly moved Firestore text search and geospatial search to general availability on October 19. Teams budgeting a backend inside the wider cloud computing stack should price both options with real traffic numbers before committing, because the cheaper platform flips depending on how your app reads data. [...] Turso acquisition, October 2. Supabase announced it is acquiring Turso. The move signals that Supabase wants to cover embedded and edge use cases beyond hosted Postgres. Expect product announcements, and watch for pricing details before you plan around them.

results.title: Supabase Announces $150M in New Funding and Turso Acquisition
results.content:
SAN FRANCISCO, Oct. 2, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Supabase, the leader in agentic infrastructure and open source Postgres development platform, today announced $150 million in new funding led by GIC, with Alphabet's independent growth fund CapitalG, IronArc, and SquarePeg also participating. The investment comes just four months after the company's $500 million Series F, as AI coding tools and agents drive another major uptick in Supabase's growth.
